question.prompt: Compared with Non-Vintage Champagne, which of the following are typical for Vintage Champagne？ a. The base wine comes from a single year. b. It is made from black gapes only. c. It may come from Spain. d. It spends longer ageing in the cellar before disgorgement. e. It is sweeter. f. It has more intense biscuit, bready autolytic characteristics.

options.text: b, d, e and f only.
